sections: Dynamic Media with OpenAPI lets Sites authors use approved assets from a remote AEM Assets environment in the Page Editor (remote assets in Content Fragments work on AEM 6.5, not on AEM as a Cloud Service); Adobe recommends it over the older Connected Assets.

Authors place brand-approved images from the DAM onto pages built with the Image v3 and Teaser v2 components (other components need custom work), and changes to approved assets reach the live site without re-uploading.
We will set the asset delivery repository and IMS client variables in Cloud Manager, configure the Image v3 component and HTTPS, and confirm authors can pick remote assets.
We will add users to the Admin Console, create user groups and attach the AEM Assets product profiles, and confirm the Cloud Manager program and environments for the DAM.
Each month we will review asset reports on usage and sharing, tidy metadata and tags, update processing profiles and manage user access.
sells: AEM Assets as a Cloud Service and AEM Dynamic Media licenses
asks: Dynamic Media with OpenAPI enabled, and the IMS Client ID issued, through an Adobe Support ticket
Applies when the DAM is a separate (remote) AEM environment
Cloud Manager variables ASSET_DELIVERY_REPOSITORY_ID and ASSET_DELIVERY_IMS_CLIENT on the Sites environment
Core Components 2.23.2 or later with Image v3; other and custom components need customization
HTTPS on every environment that uses remote assets
